_status: DRAFT - parameters for the Kanakapura run of the Sentinel-2 land-cover pipeline (adapted from ../analyze.py, Mahadevapura AC 174)
district_note: Ramanagara district (renamed Bengaluru South district in 2025); the DataMeet file labels it with the pre-2007 district name BANGALORE RURAL
scene_choice_note: All Jan-Mar acquisitions were grouped by date and relative orbit (every one over Kanakapura is orbit R019, tiles 43PGP + 43PGQ) and scored by the SCL cloud/shadow/no-data fraction inside the boundary on a 60 m mosaic (data/candidates.json). Chose 13 Feb 2019 (Sentinel-2A; 0.002% masked at 60 m, the cleanest 2019 date) and 11 Feb 2026 (Sentinel-2B; 0.000% masked), two days apart in the calendar, same orbit and tiles. This is the same date pair used for Mahadevapura. 6 Feb 2026 (Sentinel-2C) was equally clean but 7 days further from the 2019 day-of-year. 2026 had clean dates, so no 2025 fallback was needed.
